name: The Battlefords Provincial Park - South Campground
waterfront_evidence: SKPP campsite photos (campsiteDetails.do, read 2026-11-19): from 332 (open grass) Jackfish Lake shows over a band of shrubs; from 333, 334 and 335 through a thin line of aspen. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.72 m/px) with all 121 SKPP GIS site points: these west-edge sites (330-335) lie about 45-55 m from the shore by a pixel profile to open water, with a strip of trees and shrubs and the Lakeside Trail between, so a view, not on the water; 329 and 353-358 sit 60-100 m back in trees, the rest inland. Every site's detail page reads 'Near Water - no'. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290515, South loop 290859, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): 121 site-specific Nightly Electric sites 301-421, all 15/30 A, gravel pads, 96 back-in, 5 pull-through, 20 roadside; maximum equipment 18-40 ft, 111 take a 19-25 ft unit. Park map (published 16/03/2025) draws it on its own road off the main park road beside the entry gate, with a sani dump, potable water, washrooms and a service centre. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: The park's South campground, on its own road about 1.8 km down the Jackfish Lake shore from the core area.Sites 332-335 on the west edge look at the lake through trees across the Lakeside Trail; the rest sit in aspen woods. 10 sites take only an 18-ft unit. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates; 2027's are not out yet. No fall or winter camping here.
